title: Empathy-led feedback scripts and 90d ask log (personal prep)
content:
Purpose: quick, usable manager-prep artifact I can carry into 1:1s and my self-review. Built as a mix of concrete script lines, evidence snippets, and a lightweight 90-day ask tracker. Keep this messy — notes to self allowed.

Topline goals (90d):
- Stabilize hiring intake triage: reduce intake response time from 6 days -> 48 hours for high-priority reqs. Measure: average first response time in Hiring Intake Slack channel.
- Raise cross-team calibration hygiene: run 3 calibration shortcuts (15m) with Eng leads and PMs; surface 2 clear rubric changes to promotion matrix.
- Improve manager enablement: deliver 2 office hours on giving upward feedback and a one-page checklist.

Micro-commitments (weekly):
- Mon: 30m triage of hiring intake + flag blockers.
- Wed: 1h calibration notes + pull 2 promotion signals to attempt to reconcile.
- Fri: Draft ask for manager (1 paragraph) and update evidence log (3 bullet updates).

Immediate asks for next manager sync (3 bullets):
- Request 1: Support to recruit a fractional sourcer for 12 weeks (budget: ~$18k). Reason: backlog of high-priority reqs delaying launches. Evidence: 6 reqs open >45d, one cancelled offer last month.
- Request 2: Buy-in to test calibrated promotion rubric change on one microcohort (infra eng, 6 people). Pilot metrics: time-to-promotion decision, manager satisfaction.
- Request 3: Headspace/time to run two 1:1 mock sessions with junior managers before rollout.

Quick scripts (short, practiceable)
- Opening a sensitive feedback 1:1 (upward feedback you need):
  "I want to share a pattern I’ve noticed and why it matters to me and the team. My aim is not to blame — I want to be specific, help us adjust, and understand your view. Is this a good time?"
  If yes: "When X happens (specific), the consequence I see is Y (concrete example). I’d like to request Z (behavior/change) and hear your thoughts."

- When a manager gets defensive
  "I can tell this is hard to hear; I don’t want this to be a gotcha. I care about your growth. Can you help me understand where this lands for you?"

- Quick praise + micro-ask (feedback sandwich but short):
  "You did a solid job running the retro; I noticed one gap — we missed inviting eng QA early — would you be open to adding a quick QA sync next time?"

Evidence snippets to carry (1-2 lines each):
- Hiring: "Offer to candidate X failed because timeline extended 21 -> 45 days; recruiter noted candidate accepted competitor. Slack record: #hiring-intake thread (Nov-3)."
- Calibration: "Two managers disagreed on scope weighting for L4 -> L5; resulted in delayed decision. Promoted candidate later rescinded ask by manager. Doc: contrib-notes/rdw-calibration-nov24."
- Manager enablement: "Survey (n=18) after last enablement session: 54% felt confident giving upward feedback; common ask: live roleplay."

Unresolved questions / hypothesis log (shoot-from-hip):
- Hypothesis A: Faster intake triage will reduce candidate churn by 10% in 90 days. Need: baseline candidate churn metric + tracking plan.
- Question: If we pilot the rubric change, what legal/comp constraints exist for a cohort-based pilot? Who to loop in? (cc: Legal, People Ops lead)

Meeting checklist (prep before manager sync, 10m):
- Pull 2 short evidence lines (hiring + calibration).
- 1-sentence ask + 1-sentence fallback.
- 30s summary of resource ask (budget/people/time).
- 1 explicit ask for decision timing (e.g., "Can we decide by Feb 20?").

Risk notes (things to say if asked):
- On budget for fractional sourcer: "We will treat it as a time-boxed experiment with clear success metric (time-to-fill) and automatic off-ramp if not improving in 8 weeks."
- On pilot fairness: "Pilot is opt-in for managers; decisions will not lock people out of future promotion cycles."

One-page enablement outline (to iterate into slides):
- 5m: Why upward feedback matters (data point + 1 story).
- 10m: Quick model: Intent -> Specific example -> Impact -> Request. Live demo (2m).
- 20m: Paired practice (real scenarios) + coach time.
- 5m: Next steps + office hours sign-up.

Daily scratch (notes to self) - recent entries: 
- [2026-01-11] candidate pipeline: two offers slipping; pinged hiring manager + recruiter. Follow up: Monday triage.
- [2026-01-19] calibration: met with Diego, he pushed back on scope weighting; ask: bring rubric examples to sync.
- [2026-01-28] office hours sign-up low — consider asynchronous video + template.

Action backlog (priority order):
1) Draft 1-pager for fractional sourcer ask (due next Mon).
2) Pull baseline candidate churn numbers with Finance/Recruiting.
3) Schedule pilot kickoff with infra managers (tentative Feb 10).
4) Create roleplay scenarios (3) for manager office hours.

Quick links (placeholders I reference often):
- Hiring intake thread: slack://channel?team=redwood&name=hiring-intake (copy link in final doc)
- Calibration notes (internal doc): CONFLUENCE/rdw-calibration-notes
- Promotion rubric draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/people-ops/pull/4382

Notes-to-self style reminders:
- Keep scripts short. Rehearse aloud twice before sync.
- Bring one concrete candidate story for each ask — stories land.
- When manager resists, stay curious; "Tell me more" is a great redirect.

Draft email to manager (editable):
Subject: Quick sync — two asks (15m)
Hi [Manager],
I have two asks I want to run by you that impact hiring and calibration — 15 minutes would be ideal. I’ll bring: 1) one-pager on a fractional sourcer ask and 2) a small pilot proposal for a rubric tweak. Can we do 15 minutes on [two proposed times]?
Thanks — Olivia

End notes: keep this doc messy. Move things that become formal to Confluence and link. If I find repeated phrasing, capture in snippet library.

-- Olivia
